name: Text to speech
summary: Speak a text with open Hugging Face TTS models (Kokoro, Bark, MMS) on an NVIDIA GPU or the CPU: one WAV + MP3 per voice and seed.
help: Write the text to speak, pick a model and one or more voices (comma-separated). Each voice × take makes a WAV (with an MP3 copy). Kokoro 82M: best quality, fast on a CPU; voices like am_michael, am_adam, bm_george (male) or af_heart, af_bella, bf_emma (female), if_sara / im_nicola (Italian). Bark: expressive, can laugh [laughs] or hesitate (…), better on a GPU; voices v2/en_speaker_0 … v2/en_speaker_9, v2/it_speaker_0 …. MMS-TTS: light, 1,100+ languages; the voice is the ISO 639-3 language code (eng, ita, fra, deu, spa). Takes already made with the same settings are reused from the machine's cache, so changing only the filters is quick.

params.label: Voices (comma-separated)
params.help: Kokoro: am_michael, am_adam, am_eric, bm_george, bm_lewis, af_heart, af_bella, bf_emma, if_sara, im_nicola … · Bark: v2/en_speaker_6, v2/en_speaker_9, v2/it_speaker_4 … · MMS-TTS: eng, ita, fra, deu, spa …. Empty = the model's default.

params.label: Takes per voice
params.help: Bark and MMS vary with the seed; Kokoro gives the same take for the same voice and speed.

params.label: Speaking speed
params.help: Kokoro and MMS-TTS (Bark ignores it; use the filter block's speed)
